summary.text: Paul Lee has represented House District 86 (Houston County) in the Alabama House of Representatives since 2010 and serves as House Majority Leader.

paragraphs.text: A fourth-generation native and lifelong resident of Dothan, he was a Dothan City Commissioner from 2005 until his election to the House in 2010.
Before entering the legislature he spent 31 years with the Sony Corporation, retiring as a Senior Production Specialist.
According to the legislature's profile, he is Executive Director of the Wiregrass Rehabilitation Center and has served on the House Health Committee for sixteen years, eight of them as chairman.
